profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer with experience working on multiple technologies, including the analysis, design, and development of high transaction volume scalable web applications (B2B, B2C, B2A), on industries such as telecommunications, banking, enterprise financial, CRM, ERP, and HCM. I hold a BS and a MS in Computer Sciences.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Financial Investment Advisor Services Software Development Technologies

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Data Analytics and Custom Integrations development team. Implemented custom integrations enabling real time solutions for customer systems. Developed software components for automating the transformation of customer data. Implemented proven software design patterns providing extensibility, cohesiveness, and portability to the CODC platform. Implemented a solution integrating the customers HCM instance with active directory, for creating, updating, and disabling users on real time. Implemented an integrated solution for processing customer’s data feeds on demand. Developed a program for automating Jasper components deployments
-	Environment: Grails, Groovy, Java, MuleSoft, ESB, Anypoint, IntelliJ, Eclipse, PostgreSQL, REST, JSON, Jenkins, Bamboo, SVN, Jira, Splunk, Agile, Scrum, Continuous Integration, Confluence, SQL, Maven, Gradle, SOAPUI, Postman, Apache Tomcat, Kettle Pentaho, ETL, Jasper, Active Directory.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Member of the Business Components development team. Implemented complex scalable high volume transactional solutions for trading stocks for the user. Created and maintained numerous business component operations supporting diverse financial processes and applications. Created multiple services exposing operations to front end applications. SME for Defined Benefits components supporting the complete SDLC from requirements to production release and support. Successfully migrated legacy CORBA code to new architectures. Developed services for Cloud, Salesforce, EIVR, Participant Web, CSAS, PSC, and other consumers.
-	Environment: Java, J2EE, EJB, REST, JSON, WebLogic, MuleSoft API, Cloud, RAML, MicroServices, Oracle DB, TDD, Hibernate, Jenkins, Eclipse, Git, Jira, Splunk, Agile, Scrum, Continuous Integration, Confluence, SDLC, JDBC, ERD, SQL, Maven, JUnit, Spring, AppDynamics, Unix, Windows, Linux, SOAPUI, Postman, Toad, XML, UML.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Member of the Comcast Enterprise Technologies team responsible of the analysis, design, development, and maintenance of National Provisioning applications for CDV, HSD, video, email, and voice mail services.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for analysis, design and implementation of requirements for the mortgage loan service application, the Universal Decision Engine and the Accounting Transaction Services.

positions.title: Senior Lead Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Responsible for implementing the complete software development life cycle, analyzing, designing, and developing according to requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained J. D. Edwards Kernels: (1) The Queue Kernel, which manages and schedules jobs submitted for processing. (2) The Data Replication Kernel, which replicates data to remote locations on n-tier architectures. (3) The Server Administration Workbench Kernel, which monitors and reports the activity of all other active and inactive Kernels.
